summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under MTEK, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 5, 2026, disclosing receipt of a pilot order for an armored-vehicle situational awareness application from a leading global defense company, routed through a distributor. No stake, price per share, implied value, premium, or closing date is stated; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The pilot follows adaptation of the Jupiter product line to end-customer video streaming requirements. What to watch: whether the pilot converts to follow-on production orders, and any related capacity or financing disclosures.
